about.title: About ProHealthCalc
about.missionText: ProHealthCalc is dedicated to making professional-grade health calculations accessible to everyone, completely free. We believe that understanding your body metrics, nutrition needs, and health indicators should not require expensive software, complicated spreadsheets, or a medical degree. Our mission is to empower millions of people worldwide to make informed, data-driven decisions about their health and wellness.
about.storyText: ProHealthCalc was born from a simple observation: most health calculators on the internet are either inaccurate, buried behind paywalls, or missing proper medical context. We set out to build a comprehensive health calculation platform that combines clinical-grade accuracy with an intuitive user experience. What started as a handful of basic calculators has grown into a platform with over 70 specialized tools spanning body composition, nutrition, fitness, pregnancy, mental health, and more.
about.commitmentText: Every calculator on ProHealthCalc is built using peer-reviewed scientific formulas and established medical guidelines. We reference sources from organizations like the World Health Organization (WHO), National Institutes of Health (NIH), American Heart Association (AHA), and other leading medical institutions. Our editorial process includes formula verification, cross-referencing with published research, and regular updates to reflect the latest medical consensus.
about.methodologyText: We follow a rigorous development process for each calculator: First, we identify the most widely accepted and scientifically validated formula for the calculation. Then, we implement it with careful attention to edge cases and input validation. Each calculator includes comprehensive educational content explaining the science behind the calculation, how to interpret results, known limitations, and when to consult a healthcare professional. We cite our sources so you can verify the information yourself.
about.editorialText: All content on ProHealthCalc is reviewed for medical accuracy and clarity. We follow evidence-based health communication principles, clearly distinguishing between established medical facts and general wellness guidance. Our health-related content includes proper medical disclaimers, references to peer-reviewed studies, and recommendations to consult qualified healthcare professionals for personalized advice.
about.feature1: Evidence-based calculations using WHO, NIH, and AHA validated formulas with cited scientific sources
about.feature2: Complete privacy - all calculations happen in your browser, zero personal data collection or storage
about.feature3: Free forever with no hidden fees, premium tiers, or mandatory account creation
about.feature4: Mobile-optimized responsive design for accurate calculations anywhere, anytime
about.feature5: Comprehensive educational content with each calculator explaining the science, limitations, and interpretation
about.feature6: Regular updates to reflect the latest medical research and clinical guidelines

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At ProHealthCalc, we take your privacy seriously. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when you use our website and health calculator services.
privacy.dataCollectionText: We do NOT collect, store, or transmit any personal health information you enter into our calculators. All calculations are performed locally in your browser. We may collect non-personal information such as browser type, device type, operating system, and general usage patterns through analytics tools.
privacy.analyticsText: We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use our site. This includes anonymous data like page views, time on site, bounce rate, and general geographic location. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect this data. You can opt out of Google Analytics by installing the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.
privacy.cookiesText: We use essential cookies to ensure the website functions properly, analytics cookies to understand usage patterns, and advertising cookies when ads are enabled. You can manage your cookie preferences through the cookie consent banner displayed on your first visit, or through your browser settings.
privacy.thirdPartyText: We use Google Analytics and may display advertisements through Google AdSense. These services have their own privacy policies. We encourage you to review Google's Privacy Policy at https://policies.google.com/privacy.
privacy.advertisingText: We use Google AdSense to display advertisements on our website. Google AdSense uses cookies and similar technologies to serve ads based on your prior visits to our website and other websites. You can opt out of personalized advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings at https://www.google.com/settings/ads or by visiting www.aboutads.info to opt out of third-party vendor's use of cookies for personalized advertising.
privacy.advertisingCookiesText: Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your previous visits. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on your visit to our site and/or other sites on the Internet. You may opt out of personalized advertising by visiting https://www.google.com/settings/ads.
privacy.dataRetentionText: Since we do not collect personal health data, there is no health data to retain. Analytics data collected through Google Analytics is retained according to Google's data retention policies. Cookie consent preferences are stored locally on your device.
privacy.gdprText: If you are located in the European Economic Area (EEA), you have the right to: access the personal data we hold about you; request correction of inaccurate data; request deletion of your data; object to or restrict processing of your data; data portability; and withdraw consent at any time. Since our calculators process data locally in your browser and we do not store personal health information, most of these rights are automatically fulfilled. For any GDPR-related requests, please contact us at privacy@prohealthcalc.com.
privacy.ccpaText: If you are a California resident, you have the right to: know what personal information is collected about you; know whether your personal information is sold or disclosed; say no to the sale of personal information; access your personal information; and equal service and price, even if you exercise your privacy rights. We do not sell personal information. For any CCPA-related requests, please contact us at privacy@prohealthcalc.com.
privacy.childrenPrivacyText: Our services are not directed to individuals under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us immediately.
privacy.changesText: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the new privacy policy on this page and updating the 'Last Updated' date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this privacy policy or wish to exercise your privacy rights, please contact us at privacy@prohealthcalc.com or through our contact page.

contact.faqDescription: Find quick answers to common questions
contact.faq1Answer: Our calculators use scientifically validated formulas from medical research and guidelines. However, they provide estimates and should not replace professional medical advice. Always consult healthcare professionals for personalized recommendations.
contact.faq2Question: Is my data stored or shared?
contact.faq2Answer: No! All calculations happen in your browser. We don't store, collect, or share any personal health data you enter. Your privacy is our priority.
contact.faq3Question: Can I request a new calculator?
contact.faq3Answer: Absolutely! We're always looking to add useful calculators. Use the contact form above to suggest new calculators or features you'd like to see.
contact.faq4Question: Do you have a mobile app?
contact.faq4Answer: Currently, we're web-only, but our site is fully mobile-responsive. You can use all calculators seamlessly on your phone or tablet.
contact.faq5Answer: We regularly review and update our calculators to ensure they reflect the latest medical guidelines and research. Major updates are implemented as new studies emerge.
contact.faq6Question: Can I use these calculators professionally?
contact.faq6Answer: Our calculators are designed for informational purposes. Healthcare professionals can use them as reference tools, but they should not replace clinical judgment or diagnostic procedures.

disclaimer.title: Medical Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: Important information about using ProHealthCalc calculators.
disclaimer.warningText: The information and calculators provided on ProHealthCalc are for informational and educational purposes only. They are NOT intended to be a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.
disclaimer.consultationText: Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified healthcare provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have calculated or read on this website.
disclaimer.emergencyText: If you think you may have a medical emergency, call your doctor, go to the emergency department, or call emergency services immediately.
disclaimer.accuracyText: While we strive to provide accurate calculations based on established medical formulas and research, we make no warranties about the accuracy, completeness, or reliability of the calculators.
disclaimer.liabilityText: ProHealthCalc, its owners, and contributors shall not be liable for any damages arising from the use of our calculators or reliance on the information provided.
disclaimer.variabilityText: Health metrics can vary significantly between individuals. Calculator results should be interpreted in the context of your overall health, medical history, and in consultation with healthcare professionals.
